title: ThingSpeak Output
text: Write output fields to ThingSpeak channel, 1 input; {Channel number} sets the thingSpeak channel being accessed, {Configure channel parameters} selects and configure channel to access, {ThingSpeak server} sets the server for data transfer, {Channel ID} sets the unique channel, {Write API key} sets the access key for writing to channel character, {Update period (secs)} sets the write update period, in seconds, {View channel web page} sets the access web page for channel, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output fields} defines which parts of data to write, {Initial value} sets the first value transmitted and {Final value} sets the last value transmitted. Values come from the instance.
